# Hidden worker, fired from options (CHI) with the country var oe_yh_job.
oe_yh.20 = {
    type = country_event
    hidden = yes
    title = oe_yh.20.t
    trigger = { has_variable = oe_yh_job }
    immediate = {
        if = { limit = { var:oe_yh_job = 1 } oe_yh_job_1 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yh_job = 2 } oe_yh_job_2 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yh_job = 3 } oe_yh_job_3 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yh_job = 4 } oe_yh_job_4 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yh_job = 5 } oe_yh_job_5 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yh_job = 6 } oe_yh_job_6 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yh_job = 8 } oe_yh_job_8 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yh_job = 9 } oe_yh_job_9 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yh_job = 10 } oe_yh_job_10 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yh_job = 11 } oe_yh_job_11 = yes }
        if = { limit = { OR = { var:oe_yh_job = 6 var:oe_yh_job = 8 } } oe_yh_tier_step = yes }
        remove_variable = oe_yh_job
    }
}
